title: Jungle Expedition

reviewPolicy.reason: Player visual judgment remains authoritative. Pass 11 adds a deeper river ecosystem, volumetric canopy shading, deterministic weather lighting, three captured Emerald Zenith beats, and a jungle-specific Lost City construction rig, but does not self-certify the active 10/10 goal.

interactiveOverviewObserved.notes: The live high-quality clear overview includes the interactive route and actors while keeping the enriched five-step river cascade and layered jungle below 180k triangles.

interactiveStormObserved.notes: The active storm adds one bounded rain and sunray field draw call; named sky and sun lights darken the complete island between deterministic lightning flashes.

viteProductionBuild.notes: Existing mixed static/dynamic import and large chunk warnings remain; the production bundle completed successfully.

implementedVisualSystems: the grounded hero river now descends through five readable cascade lips into a broad turquoise foreground pool, with compact foam, submerged pebbles, wet lost-city relics, strangler roots, reeds, orchids, and planted banks folded into existing batches

procedural canopy crowns use faux surface normals, depth, directional diffuse light, facets, and vein shading instead of flat fluorescent discs, preserving a multilayer 3D forest from foreground understory to the distant jungle wall
the retained ecology contains eight grounded exotic species and eighteen animated aerial individuals spanning birds, butterflies, hummingbirds, and dragonflies

the 180-second weather story exposes deterministic clear, gathering, storm, lightning, sunbreak, and recovery evidence states while animating cloud cover, rain, sky fill, key sunlight, turquoise bounce, wet-water response, and recovery rays

Emerald Zenith now has separately evidenced ruin ascension, waterfall reversal, and sky opening beats with a living vine helix, temple beam, compass glyph wave, water crown, jungle pulse rings, and camera choreography

the Lost City construction preview preserves its monumental authored scale while using a dedicated dark-rootwood, moss-bronze, and emerald vineworks profile with slimmer translucent temple crane geometry
five additive landmark construction stories, all five L3 landmark identities, east and west route tunnels, and the canonical five-stage Living Compass mission remain intact
all new scenery is procedural Three.js geometry, instancing, generated shader detail, light, or in-memory generated texture; the supplied 2D source is never rendered in the island
